historical_source_metadata.purpose: A second tracker file in the same repo demonstrating that federated_trackers actually federate. The directory page fetches this URL alongside index.json and merges the entries (deduped by neighborhood_rappid). Anyone running their own tracker exposes their index at any URL; trackers reference each other to compose a multi-tracker view of the metropolis. No central authority.

protocol.merge_rule: Entries are deduped by neighborhood_rappid; canonical index entries take precedence on conflict; unique-to-peer entries are added with a `from_tracker` annotation in the merged view.
protocol.self_reference_safe: A tracker can list itself in federated_trackers without infinite recursion — the directory page tracks fetched URLs and skips duplicates.

immutable_grail_evidence.policy: read-only evidence; no executable install or download action

legacy_identity_policy: Preserve every recorded value byte-for-byte and present it only as a historical, unaccepted identifier.
